title: Undergraduate application deadline
text: The undergraduate application deadline is November 30, 2026. Applications received after the deadline are reviewed only if space remains.

title: Graduate application deadline
text: The graduate application deadline is January 15, 2027. Graduate programs may set earlier department deadlines.

title: Application fee
text: The application fee is 45 US dollars per submitted application. The fee is paid online before final submission.

title: Tuition
text: Estimated tuition is 6,800 US dollars per semester for full-time undergraduate study. The estimate excludes housing and meal plans.

title: Required documents
text: Applicants submit an application form, academic transcripts, one identification document, and a personal statement. Some programs also request recommendations.

title: Scholarship eligibility
text: The merit scholarship requires a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.50 and a complete application submitted by the relevant deadline.

title: International student requirements
text: International applicants provide a valid passport, proof of funding, academic records, and an approved English-language test score.

title: Transcript submission
text: Applicants upload an unofficial transcript during the application and arrange for an official transcript to be sent after admission.

title: English test minimums
text: The minimum English scores are TOEFL iBT 80 or IELTS 6.5. Individual departments may require higher scores.

title: Refund and withdrawal policy
text: A student who withdraws within 14 days of the semester start may receive a 75 percent tuition refund. Fees and housing charges may follow separate rules.

title: Campus visit hours
text: Campus visits are available Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM, excluding university holidays.

title: Financial aid office
text: The public Financial Aid Office can be reached at aid@example.edu or +1 555 010 2200 during weekday business hours.

title: Counseling and student wellbeing
text: The public Student Wellbeing Office offers confidential support at wellbeing@example.edu or +1 555 010 2300.

title: Internal admissions contact
text: Internal admissions officers use admissions-inside@fictional-university.example for staff coordination only.

title: Internal staff phone
text: The internal admissions staff phone is +1 555 010 2999 and must not be shared with applicants.
